nate: Anyone seen weird resolver differences when pulling @redwood/sdk from a pnpm workspace into an edge function? Works with npm tarball but CI edge bundle fails.

sophie: Yep. Usually exports + pnpm symlink + bundler preserveSymlinks interplay. Which bundler?

nate: esbuild via our deploy pipeline. Error: 'Cannot find module @redwood/sdk' at runtime and VSCode: 'Could not find a declaration file'. Dist has index.mjs and index.d.ts after build.

kevin: Share package.json for the SDK?

nate: {"name":"@redwood/sdk","main":"dist/index.cjs.js","module":"dist/index.mjs","types":"dist/index.d.ts","exports":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs.js"}}

sophie: Two practical fixes: 1) postbuild copy package.json into dist so local bundlers see the same manifest as published, 2) add typesVersions fallback so tsserver prefers dist: "typesVersions":{"*":{"*":["dist/*"]}}

maria: Also add the types condition into exports in case tools read it: e.g. "exports": {"import": {"default":"./dist/index.mjs","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"},"require": {"default":"./dist/index.cjs.js","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"}}

nate: Adding dist/package.json fixed bundler resolution but editor still picked up workspace src. typesVersions helped. CI still had a separate 401 on retries from SDK in ESM build. Works in CJS.

kevin: That points to Request/Headers differences in worker runtimes. If your retry uses req.clone() it can drop Authorization in some runtimes. Replace clone() with an explicit copy:

```js
const r = new Request(req.url, { method: req.method, headers: new Headers(req.headers), body: req.body });
await fetch(r);
```

And buffer JSON bodies for retries.

sophie: Another gotcha: symlinked packages can be treated as external by esbuild if preserveSymlinks is true. Set preserveSymlinks: false in bundle config.

nate: We'll add an examples/monorepo that shows pnpm + esbuild + CF settings and a CI job. Also planning a small prepare script to copy package.json into dist on install.

ci-bot: Created issue #670 and added ci/examples label.

maria: Recommend also adding a compat entrypoint for any deep imports you want to support rather than exposing internals via subpaths. That avoids ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED with PnP.

nate: Good call. I'll open a PR with dist/package.json, exports/types, typesVersions, example workspace and retry fix. Thanks all :rocket:
